scope.owner: exercise 438, including its teaching footnote, not 33 or 440

modernRegularization: Make a and b exactly parallel while retaining both positive slopes and c as the steeper positive slope.
Use clean exact circular arcs and concentric radii. Single/double arcs remain source marks; no numeric angle values are asserted or displayed.
Place larger modern digits on the same source sectors. Independent visible-label sector checks must use this frozen pixel-derived map.
Crossings may be hidden construction anchors but must not acquire visible markers or new labels.
identityLimits: All eight digits and the letters a, b, c are readable in the original full crop; no digit identity is UNKNOWN.
Crossing names are absent; hidden coordinate anchors in a deterministic construction are not source point names.
Exact angle measures, arc radii and distances are not source given data.
Short irregular holes in thin scan strokes are not evidence of an intentional dashed semantic object. The modern strokes may be continuous solid.
The enlarged crops assist thin-stroke inspection only. They do not replace the approved full-source pixel inventory or authorize a source-page rerender.
